rooms.name: The Copper Lantern
rooms.description: Firelight warms a low room of dark oak and river stone. Travelers speak quietly beneath a copper lantern that never seems to dim.

features.name: copper lantern
features.description: Its flame bends toward the north, though no draft touches the room.

rooms.name: The Rusted Gate
rooms.description: Rain runs down the remains of an iron portcullis. A narrow road continues north into the marsh. Fresh tracks lead east.

features.name: fresh tracks
features.description: The tracks belong to something heavy and three-legged. They are less than an hour old.

rooms.name: Market Lane
rooms.description: Canvas awnings snap above shuttered stalls. Chalk marks on the cobbles count debts nobody admits to owing.

features.name: chalk marks
features.description: Seven names repeat in a careful hand. The eighth has been scrubbed away.

rooms.name: The Drowned Orchard
rooms.description: Rows of dead apple trees rise from black water. Pale fruit hangs from one branch, untouched by rot.

features.name: pale fruit
features.description: The skin is cold and flawless. Something shifts inside when you touch it.

creatures.name: marsh crawler
creatures.description: A mud-armored thing balanced on three hooked limbs.
